title: User reiterates full animation quality bar
content: The user explicitly reiterates that the login must be sufficiently impressive with a complete animation experience at the aspirational craft level of Astra and Antigravity, while remaining original. Read the new quality acceptance section at the top of docs/agent-bridge/approved-login-concept.md. Phase A is only an internal cheap composition check, never the final deliverable. The finished experience requires authored entrance, spatial materials and lighting, smooth pointer response, deliberate ambient life, polished form-state transitions and mobile composition. Codex and Claude will inspect real motion footage and request revisions if it is still generic. Do not claim world-class quality based only on a report or working code. Continue the bounded Phase A assignment, then the reviewed Phase B.
